name: Black-capped Chickadee
facts: Call pattern: the song is a simple two-note whistle, "fee-bee." In the "chick-a-dee" call, more "dee" notes signal a bigger threat.
Habitat: mixed woods, thickets and feeders. Hides seeds one at a time and can remember thousands of hiding spots.
Migration: none. On cold nights it lowers its body temperature to save energy.
